Read a UTM zone as entered

Source: R/fiss_parse.R
knw_fiss_utm_zone.Rd

Submitters write the zone as "10", "11U", "10 U" or "zone 11". The letter is the latitude band (all of BC is U or V), so the zone is the leading digits. Read as a plain number, "11U" was NA on 116 sites each in two North Thompson groups, which were then never placed.

Usage

knw_fiss_utm_zone(x)

Arguments

x

a vector of zones as entered.

Value

numeric, the zone, or NA where x carries no digits.

Examples

knw_fiss_utm_zone(c("10", "11U", "10 U", "zone 11", "", NA))
#> [1] 10 11 10 11 NA NA
